name: Automatic pet feeder
summary: 1.3 l printed hopper over an auger turned by a 28BYJ-48 stepper, timed by an ESP32 on USB power; stays upright with a full hopper.

spec.name: Automatic Pet Feeder
spec.function: Feeds a cat or small dog dry food on a schedule: a printed hopper drops food into a horizontal auger, a 28BYJ-48 stepper turns the auger to push a portion out of the spout, and an ESP32 runs the schedule over Wi-Fi from USB power.
spec.quote: Design an automatic pet feeder for dry food with a hopper of at least a litre, a stepper-driven auger and an ESP32, on USB power, under 30 euros and 900 g. The motor needs at least 1.5 times the torque the food needs, and it must not tip over with a full hopper.

parts.name: Base housing
parts.description: Closed box 160 x 140 x 60 mm centred on X=Y=0 (Z 0 to 60) with 2.2 mm walls, holding the stepper and the ESP32. An auger tube of 44 mm bore runs along X at Z=35 from X=-55 through the +X wall as a 25 mm spout with a drop slot underneath, and a 40 mm chute joins the tube to the top plate at X=Y=0.

parts.name: Hopper
parts.description: Open-top square hopper 120 x 120 x 100 mm on the base top (Z 60 to 160) with 1.8 mm walls and floor and a 40 mm outlet at X=Y=0 over the chute; about 1.3 litres inside.

parts.name: Auger
parts.description: Shaft 10 mm thick and 140 mm long along X at Y=0, Z=35 from X=-50, with a stepped flight of 3 mm blades 40 mm across turned 30 degrees apart, and a 14 mm coupler with a 5 mm shaft bore at the motor end.

parts.name: Stepper motor with driver
parts.description: Turns the auger from the -X end

parts.name: USB-C cable and 5 V wall adapter
parts.query: USB-C cable and 5 V 2 A wall adapter

requirements.text: Stepper gives at least 1.5 times the torque the food needs
requirements.quote: The motor needs at least 1.5 times the torque the food needs

requirements.text: Tips only beyond 20 degrees with a full hopper
requirements.quote: it must not tip over with a full hopper

requirements.text: Settles within 5 degrees after a 2 N push on the full hopper
requirements.quote: it must not tip over with a full hopper

stepper.reason: Geared 5 V stepper with its ULN2003 board: slow, strong for its size and runs from USB.

mcu.reason: Wi-Fi for the schedule and a feed log, 5 V from the same USB supply; the cheapest ESP32 board in stock.

power.reason: 5 V 2 A runs the stepper (1.2 W) and the ESP32 together.
